description: Source code for expression handling and manipulation in a configuration system, including functions for creating, copying, freeing, transforming, and printing expression trees, as well as evaluating and simplifying expressions.

methods.name: expr_alloc_symbol
methods.description: Allocates a new expression node representing a symbol.

methods.name: expr_alloc_one
methods.description: Allocates a new expression node of a given type with a single child expression.

methods.name: expr_alloc_two
methods.description: Allocates a new expression node of a given type with two child expressions.

methods.name: expr_alloc_comp
methods.description: Allocates a comparison expression node between two symbols.

methods.name: expr_alloc_and
methods.description: Creates an AND expression from two expressions, with optimization for null inputs.

methods.name: expr_alloc_or
methods.description: Creates an OR expression from two expressions, with optimization for null inputs.

methods.name: expr_copy
methods.description: Deep copies an expression tree.

methods.name: expr_free
methods.description: Frees an expression tree.

methods.name: expr_eliminate_eq
methods.description: Eliminates equality expressions by simplifying or replacing them.

methods.name: expr_eliminate_dups
methods.description: Eliminates duplicate sub-expressions and simplifies expression trees.

methods.name: expr_transform
methods.description: Transforms expressions by simplifying boolean logic and comparisons.

methods.name: expr_contains_symbol
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains a specific symbol.

methods.name: expr_depends_symbol
methods.description: Checks if an expression depends on a specific symbol with certain conditions.

methods.name: expr_trans_compare
methods.description: Translates expressions to compare against a symbol with a specific relation.

methods.name: expr_calc_value
methods.description: Calculates the boolean value of an expression.

methods.name: expr_get_leftmost_symbol
methods.description: Returns the leftmost symbol in an expression tree.

methods.name: expr_simplify_unmet_dep
methods.description: Returns the leftmost symbol of a sub-expression not depending on a given symbol.

methods.name: expr_print
methods.description: Prints an expression using a callback function.

methods.name: expr_fprint
methods.description: Prints an expression to a FILE stream.

methods.name: expr_gstr_print
methods.description: Prints an expression to a grow string with formatting.
